basis: Andrew Fisher, 31 Oct 2026 ~04:3x AEST (this chat): "Can we change all my start times to 6am please". Every one of his labour rows that starts at 06:30 is set to start at 06:00 through the page's own setOurCost; the page works the hours out again from start and finish (06:00 to 17:00 is 11 h). Rows already starting at 06:00 (the first week and the race weekend) are left as they are. His hours are salary hours, hours only, so no figure on the P&L moves.
